page0.text:
"...All right. Thank god for small mercies."
I need to figure out exactly what's wrong with me, or I won't be able to act.
I'm still conscious.
As long as I don't space out, I can be aware of my situation, like I have been so far.

page1.text:
"...Wait, what am I doing here, again?"
I wonder why I'm in the shed.
Sakura's warning.
Sakura told us to run. Tohsaka said that she'd fight.
And, and then...oh yeah, we have to go to a cavern under Ryudou Temple.

page2.text:
"So what am I doing on the floor of the shed when we're going to Ryudou Temple?"
I've fallen on the ground.
When I came to, I was sprawled out in the shed.
My right arm throbs in pain.
Thanks to that, I'm fully awake.

page3.text:
"...Dammit. Get it together, dumbass."
I stand up and check the feeling in my arms and legs.
...I don't feel so good.
I'm losing something at alarming speed.
It isn't critical.
I should be able to fight like I have so far until morning, at least.

page4.text: "You look awful. Do you recognize me, Shirou?"

page5.text:
"...!"
I gasp and whirl around.
Deep within the shed, where the moonlight doesn't reach,
a black-clothed Servant stands in the dark.

page6.text: "Rider. Have you been here this whole..."

page7.text:
"Yes. I have been monitoring you.
My orders are to protect Shirou Emiya, but Sakura is my Master. If you threaten her, I cannot protect you.
That is why I didn't help you in the forest. It is your own doing that you were chased by Berserker."

page8.text:
Rider coolly explains.
She's very businesslike.
It seems that she was waiting for me to be alone.

page9.text:
"...Oh. So you're here now..."
"To kill you. You are Sakura's enemies. I cannot let you go to her."
Rider is holding her stake-shaped daggers.
She inches closer, her murderous intent clear.
